resources.string: No mistakes to review at this level. Well done!
Practise every day, pass the level exam and earn your certificate.
Take the %1$d-question placement test (%2$d minutes) and we will recommend your level.
How do I earn a certificate?

Practise a level until you have answered at least %1$d%% of all its questions, with at least %2$d%% of your latest answers correct, and pass its three short checkpoint tests on questions you have not practised. A mistake can be reviewed after 24 hours and counts as fixed after two right answers on different days.
The level\'s final exam then unlocks: %1$d questions in %2$d minutes, chosen from an exam-only bank so they are new to you. A retake never repeats questions from your earlier exams.
Score %1$d%% or more, then your teacher approves the result and your certificate is issued as a PDF with a QR code anyone can scan to check it.
Did not pass? Review your mistakes; the next attempt opens after %1$d hours.
